answer: The protocol implements dynamic opportunity-cost bonds requiring heavy collateral within an isolated island of liquidity to mitigate credential dilution. By deploying subgame-perfect slashing matrices, the system transforms a potential haven for adversaries into a zone where the cost of Sybil multiplication exceeds the marginal gain of any singular pearl. This asymmetry forces the expected utility of agent expansion to remain strictly negative, thereby securing a robust Nash equilibrium throughout the hostile multi-agent landscape.
